subject: Retire input-incomplete old sword-strike trace
description: COMPLETED WITHOUT A RUST CHANGE. The old schema-12 capture `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_045/replay-014-session-0001.jsonl.zst` reaches its current independent ten-field PC99 melee/command frontier after frame 1298: Original executes `SwordstrikeThrustA`/animation 67 while Rust remains in `MoveOk`/animation 304. The causative frame-1296-to-1297 command records Original PC101, Soldier58, `swordstrike_thrust_a`, and `with_seek=true`, but omits the resolved seek distance. Original's simple-click `MOUSEWAYPATTERN_NONE` path emits command A while using 90% of the weapon's generic maximum distance, because `ConvertMousePatternToStrike(NONE)` returns `END_OF_REAL_STRIKE`; the THRUST_A gesture emits the same command A and `with_seek=true` while using 90% of thrust A's maximum (`original-code/RHengine.cpp:15709-15730`, `15755-15778`, `15829-15861`; `original-code/RHSword.cpp:247-252`). The actor-target separation at issuance is about 65.70 units, and the recorded Original immediately enters the strike while Rust's historical thrust-specific fallback seeks, but that later outcome cannot generally reconstruct the omitted input provenance. Current `RHParity::RecordSwordStrike` serializes `seek_distance` explicitly (`original-code/RHParity.cpp:1803-1810`), and Rust accepts that resolved field while preserving an unavoidable compatibility fallback for older records (`crates/robin_engine/src/player_command.rs:118-127`; `crates/robin_engine/src/engine/commands.rs:3524-3538`). Selecting either old-record fallback as universally authoritative would be speculative and could corrupt the opposite input class, so this one input-incomplete trace is retired pending deterministic modern recapture rather than adding trace-specific gameplay behavior. The separately retained schema-14 `Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_045/replay-014` matches exact EOF on the current optimized runner; it is a modern same-named control, not claimed as a byte-equivalent save replacement.
